total_supply_after_constructor.meaning: totalSupply value set by the constructor, including the 1 000 000 ghost shares
total_supply_after_constructor.checkpoint: after constructor, before any deposit or withdrawal

ghost_share_count.meaning: number of shares counted in totalSupply that are never minted to any account (1 000 000)

sum_balance_of.meaning: sum of balanceOf[] over all accounts, i.e. actually minted shares
sum_balance_of.checkpoint: after constructor, before any deposit or withdrawal

assets_released_per_share.meaning: assets released per redeemed share in a withdrawal, computed with totalSupply as denominator

fair_assets_per_share.meaning: fair pro-rata assets per share that redemption should release absent the inflated denominator

assumptions: The constructor state (totalSupply including 1 000 000 ghost shares) persists into the withdrawal scenario.
Redemption uses totalSupply as the scaling denominator, so the phantom shares enter it.
fair_assets_per_share is the pro-rata amount a share should release; the report does not give its numeric formula.

unresolved.description: The report does not state the exact redemption formula operands or numeric expected-versus-actual assets-per-share amounts, so fair_assets_per_share cannot be derived numerically.
No concrete withdrawal transaction, caller, or trigger action is described; the under-pay is a standing consequence of the constructor state.

limitations: assets_released_per_share and fair_assets_per_share are symbolic per-share quantities; the report supplies no numeric definition, so the relation is qualitative.
The plan formalizes only the withdrawals_underpay impact; deposits_overmint and permanent_disadvantage are handled in separate passes.
The ghost-share count is bound only as a lower bound on totalSupply because the report gives no other supply components.
